evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To evaluate these broader capabilities, we introduce RLE-Bench, a benchmark of robot-learning tasks spanning four representative robotics development workflows: interactive control, policy learning, perception and estimation, and mechanical design.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Coding agents are beginning to move beyond purely digital tasks to tackle physical-world challenges, particularly in robotics.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We use diverse task-specific metrics to evaluate the artifacts submitted by the coding agents, from the success rate the agents achieved to the policy agents trained, the harness agent built, and the mechanical structures the agent designed.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We aggregate these metrics into an overall RLE Index and report workflow-specific capability profiles, enabling systematic comparison of coding agents' capabilities across multiple capability dimensions.
